name: ROCm 10.0.0 Compatibility Matrix
notes: ROCm 10.0.0 compatibility matrix. Supports CDNA4 (gfx950: MI350X/MI350P/MI355X), CDNA3 (gfx942: MI325X/MI300X/MI300A), CDNA2 (gfx90a: MI250X/MI250/MI210), CDNA (gfx908: MI100). AI ecosystem: PyTorch 2.11-2.13, vLLM 0.27.0, SGLang 0.5.15, JAX 0.10-0.11. Key for ROCm deployment planning.
